Excelling in the tenor buffo repertoire, Reiss was particularly associated with the roles of David in Wagner's "Die Meistersinger von Nürnberg" and Mime in Wagner's "Der Ring des Nibelungen", two roles he sang in numerous houses internationally.»

His US debut was in February 2012 as Radames in "Aida" at the Metropolitan Opera following by another summer performance that year.
